owner_authorized: 2026-10-18, in chat: 'yes set up the avoid list'
role: A forward AVOID list, not a strategy. A25 v1 and v2 (Steps 365, 367) found that liquid firms newly disclosing a relationship with a current market leader underperformed same-SIC2 controls (12m: -1.67% 2012-18, -8.63% 2019-25 for genuine relationships). Both windows have been seen, so the only clean evidence is forward.

rule.quarter: each completed calendar quarter Q, starting with 2026Q3
rule.leaders: at the start of Q: among the 200 most liquid stocks in the clean weekly panel (close >= $5, latest available 63-day median dollar volume >= $5M), the 20 with the highest trailing 52-week return; leaders in SIC2 60/61/62/67 dropped (A25 v2)
rule.names: A25's cleaned as-filed names (FSDS through 2022Q4; for later filers the EDGAR submissions name), with A25's ambiguous-word exclusion
rule.mentions: EDGAR full-text search, 10-K/10-Q/8-K and exhibits filed in Q; a NEW mention = a filer naming the leader in Q and in none of the four prior quarters
rule.relationship_filter: A25 v2's sentence rule, verbatim from config/leader_mentions_registry_v2.json (relationship terms present, exclusion terms absent, same sentence)
rule.exclusions: the leader itself, the leader's SIC3, the leader's ETNIC-3 peers (latest ETNIC year available, 2023, declared), firms not liquid at the decision
rule.controls: for each avoid firm, 50 random liquid same-SIC2 firms that are not on the list and not ETNIC peers of the named leader(s), seed fixed per quarter and stored

cadence.decision: recorded by the first run on or after Q's end + 14 days (late filings); entry prices are the latest weekly close in the clean weekly panel at recording
cadence.missed_policy: a quarter not recorded within 60 days of its end is left missed and never reconstructed

scoring: 52 weeks after each decision: the avoid firms' equal-weight 52-week return minus the mean of their controls' (each firm against its own 50 controls, then averaged); recorded once, hash-chained

reading_fixed_in_advance.confirms_the_avoid_rule_if: after four scored quarters, the mean avoid-minus-control 52-week return is below -2% AND at least three of four quarters are negative
reading_fixed_in_advance.refutes_it_if: the mean is above 0 after four scored quarters

sec_access: EDGAR full-text search and data.sec.gov with the project's anonymous agent; SEC Archives with a contact agent read from the environment variable SEC_USER_AGENT or the gitignored file config/local/sec_user_agent.txt, never stored in the repository
log_policy: decisions and observations are independently hash-chained (src/systematic_trader/forward_evidence.py); each quarter's list and controls are written to a CSV whose sha256 is pinned in the decision
mutation_policy: any change to the leaders, filter, exclusions, controls or scoring creates v2 and restarts
